## 2026-11-22 当前代码核对

Agent: ChatGPT，按当前用户授权核对与治理。审计截止 [`a8bf56087`](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/commit/a8bf56087e5836e3c14c153cafbd796bd98bff37)；各项执行证据保留其实际 SHA。

核对基线：[`2c7eae25357d`](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/commit/2c7eae25357d0c5bae29bd5e92caae3a4ea39730)。

- [x] **两行投影与 Inspector 文档增量已整合**：[权威矩阵](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/2c7eae25357d0c5bae29bd5e92caae3a4ea39730/internal/agent-harness/dogfood-coverage-matrix.md)及[派生 consumerRows](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/2c7eae25357d0c5bae29bd5e92caae3a4ea39730/internal/coverage-matrices/prototype-coverage-matrix.json)一致；本次原有五个 projection 测试 5/5 通过。
- [x] **follow-up 引用链已发布**：[#1429](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1429)／[#1431](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1431)保留 #745、#531 与既有贡献出处。
- [ ] 完成原 M0 处置、完整矩阵检查与精确 head 独立验收；#513/#514 的历史延期关闭不证明 M0 完成。[原失败与验收缺口](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/2c7eae25357d0c5bae29bd5e92caae3a4ea39730/internal/records/2026-11-11-editor-inspector-matrix-projection-sync.md)继续保留；Inspector/editor 实现仍属原 0.4 范围。

主线增量核对截止 [`a8bf56087e58`](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/commit/a8bf56087e5836e3c14c153cafbd796bd98bff37)；本段已执行的测试仍绑定 `2c7eae25357d`，不重标为新 main 运行。

- [x] **后续派生矩阵修复已整合**：[#1664](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1664)刷新原有consumer字段与source bindings，两条editor rows的已有投影保留；[来源记录](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/a8bf56087e5836e3c14c153cafbd796bd98bff37/internal/records/2026-11-22-regression-source-bindings.md)明确保留最终完整4491项中4489pass/1fail/1skip及随后单例修复的不同receipt，未伪合成为完整新head全绿。原CI/独立验收条件仍开放。

---

Agent: dot

### Current Harness direction — 2026-10-27

Application-facing planning/source baseline: Proto UI main `2ecb2a0248af55384f048cacb3256c1f4a4deb0a`. This is not a passing-test or new implementation receipt. New receipts must bind their actual current main base and candidate head separately.

The current user-directed scope supersedes incompatible historical Brutalist-only presentation, mandatory persistent three-column workspace, mandatory always-expanded activity and mandatory parallel Agent lanes. Use the latest **repository-owned Proto shadcn at the pinned source**; no upstream shadcn/Radix UI stack is imported. Keep React19 as the current host unless separately changed. Historical decisions, contributions, screenshots, failures and completed slices remain below at their original source bindings.

Target a reusable Harness reference consumer: one continuous subject/mainline; legitimate public activity is nonblocking; explicit waits distinguish input/authorization/external completion. Tool progress/ack/result receipts/failure/authorization, recovery/node/attempt identity and time are App facts, never inferred success. Artifacts open an on-demand desktop nonmodal/mobile modal Inspector. Plugin capability presentation does not move execution/security/transport into Proto. Shenko is a downstream validation application, not the sole domain model. Low-noise Claude/Linear/Apple-HIG references are design aims, not conformance claims.

Current shadcn manifest0.3.0-alpha.1 declares input/label/collapsible/accordion/field/card/drawer/popover/tree/message-scroller/resizable/virtual-list/style-scope/input-shell exports. Old proposals alone do not establish missing current implementation; inspect authored source, generated facade, built/installed artifact and actual consumer separately. Private Message requires Header(1)+Content(1); low-noise presentation must preserve that anatomy or coordinate a compatible owner delta.

#### This item: Preserve delivered editor-row projection; verify delta

Two editor rows/derived JSON were delivered by merged#928. Do not repeat them or expand into editor implementation; verify remaining acceptance against currentHEAD.

| Relationship | Current bounded meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Hard prerequisites | The #514 new requirement inventory and already-delivered #928 editor rows; audit the delta only. |
| Collaboration / later consumption (not hard gates) | #531 historical research and #529 future editor consumption; no repeated #928 work. |
| Retained exclusions | old wait-for-#563 and Oct22 Draft wording are historical, not current blockers. |

New acceptance to verify (not completed): Assess new Inspector requirements as explicit deltas while retaining research/infrastructure exemptions and old validation failures.

Existing implementation owners and accepted generic contracts remain. Empty assignees/expired leases do not transfer ownership; Project custom owner fields are unknown. This scope update does not claim implementation, new tests, admission, lifecycle promotion or completion, and does not replace actual owner coordination.

AI assistance: OpenAI Dots

<details>
<summary>Historical scope and evidence — retained verbatim; superseded presentation is identified above</summary>

## Follow-up to #531 (closed)

[#531](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/issues/531) was closed after [PR #614](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/614) merged its Text Document Surface research boundary. That research result remains complete; this Issue does not reopen or revise it. One separate acceptance item in #531 remains unfulfilled: “#513/#514 matrix rows and re-review trigger are updated.” The merged [research record](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/main/internal/records/2026-09-05-text-document-surface-boundary.md#513514-matrix-consumption) explicitly deferred that projection until the matrix carrier [PR #563](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/563) lands. As of 2026-09-27, #563 is open with an active change request, and #514 remains open.

## Bounded work

After #563 is independently accepted and merged, update only these two rows in `internal/agent-harness/dogfood-coverage-matrix.md`:

- `harness.future.editor-chrome`: replace pending ownership with the option-C recommendation from the #531 record; retain `research` until semantic admission; link the record, distinguish Textarea/Code Block/static Diff fallbacks, and name the proposed Contract/Module/Host Capability/Test checkpoint. Trigger re-review on admission outcome, selection position encoding, syntax/diagnostics, multi-document or large-document scope, or non-Web claims.
- `harness.future.editor-engine`: retain `infrastructure-exempt`; explain that model, content edits, undo, selection, rendering, tokenization and view-state internals remain engine infrastructure. Trigger re-review on engine selection, persistence/service binding, raw-model leakage or capability expansion.

Recompute matrix totals only if a row state changes. Link the landed #531 record and matrix carrier from #513; keep #514 as owner of the single matrix. No editor implementation, new spec entity, semantic admission, engine selection, or third-party UI dependency is authorized here.

## Acceptance

- [x] **Both exact rows above and their re-review triggers reflect the merged #531 research result, without copying the record into a second source of truth.**
- [ ] #513 points to the landed record and matrix carrier; #514 retains the authoritative matrix link and remains open until its own M0 criteria pass.
- [ ] The matrix checker and focused tests pass on the candidate, then exact-head CI and independent review pass before merge.
- [x] **The follow-up PR references this Issue and #531 without auto-closing or rewriting the original.**

## Agent evidence

Agent's sanitized paraphrase of the current maintainer request: audit recently closed Issues for unfinished acceptance work and create a linked, well-labeled follow-up. Source: the maintainer direction in this task and the public #531/#514 discussion. The observed state is #531 closed via merged #614 while its own matrix-consumption paragraph and acceptance checkbox still defer the two rows to #563. This is a documentation/ownership dependency, not a visual component defect; no screenshot is claimed. Evidence is partial until #563 lands and the two-row PR passes its checker and review. The next Agent action is to update those rows against the merged carrier, then verify the matrix and #513 links.

</details>

## #745 · editor consumerRows projection sync landed

<!-- p745-consumerrows-sync-1429-c60926b -->

What landed: [PR #1429](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1429), merged into `main` as `c60926b57595aca5d813b40bd1d166c489a5a599`, contribution head `ffd95676adabb811a620a59f70ed5452317bb394`.

### The actual gap

The merged [PR #1417](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1417) rewrote the two editor rows in `internal/agent-harness/dogfood-coverage-matrix.md` to carry the on-demand Inspector delta, but did not regenerate the derived projection. The authoritative ledger text and the derived `consumerRows` entries in `internal/coverage-matrices/prototype-coverage-matrix.json` therefore disagreed, and the derived `issues` index still omitted `#928`.

PR #1429 closed only that derivation gap. It synchronized the two editor `consumerRows` entries field-by-field through the canonical `consumerLedgerRows` producer in `scripts/coverage-matrices/prototype-coverage.mjs` — 11 fields plus the derived `issues` index, 13 changes in total. This is the same bounded scope the 2026-10-18 comment recorded as authorized ("仅同步上述两个对象的13个字段及派生 issues 索引"), and it is the same scope the 2026-10-22 claim registered ("必要的两个 derived consumerRows 的13字段及 issues 索引"). Row IDs, states (`research` / `infrastructure-exempt`), milestones, difficulty, exemptions, original re-review triggers, all other consumer rows, and all counts are unchanged.

### Verification on the candidate

- `node scripts/coverage-matrices/test/editor-boundary-projection.test.mjs` — 5/5 pass.
- `node scripts/coverage-matrices/prototype-coverage.mjs` — the 11 `Consumer source field drift` errors this sync targeted are 0 on the candidate; the same 11 are present on the pre-sync source, so they measure the stale projection rather than an unrelated condition.
- `node scripts/coverage-matrices/test/prototype-coverage.test.mjs` — 120 cases, 69 failures before the sync and 55 after, with **no case regressed**. The 14 newly passing cases are the ledger/JSON agreement assertions the stale entries had broken, including `review 4198701671: consumer program and exact ledger are closed sets`.
- Exact-head CI on the merged head: DCO, `test-plan`, `lockstep-check`, `ci-config-audit` and `public_package_plan` all pass. Vercel failed on an account deployment rate limit, not on code.

### Honest limits

This is a derived-projection synchronization only. No editor implementation, no new spec entity, no semantic admission, no engine selection, no third-party editor dependency, and no change to the `research` / `infrastructure-exempt` states. The 55 residual `prototype-coverage` failures are pre-existing source-state gaps in this checkout — the retained Shadcn style manifest pins `LICENSE.md` while it is stored under `upstream/`, `P-BASE-MENUBAR` cites two Base families without one inherited owner, and the GPUI native-receipt cases lack their bound receipts. The readable views `internal/coverage-matrices/prototype-coverage-matrix.md` and `internal/coverage-matrices/finf-delivery-checklist.md` were **not** regenerated: the canonical `--write` path fails candidate-source validation on current main for the same `LICENSE.md` reason, and those views are already stale on main for unrelated JSON drift. Both gaps pre-date this change and remain with #870's reconciliation.

### Reconciliation of the 2026-11-06 statements

Those comments recorded that `internal/agent-harness/dogfood-coverage-matrix.md` no longer exists on current main and that the row-update work was therefore moot. That does not describe current main: the path exists, and merged PR #1417 landed on it on 2026-11-10. The dated statements are preserved rather than rewritten. The Inspector/editor runtime capability they deferred to 0.4 stays deferred — this projection changes only the derived metadata that tracks the authoritative ledger.

### Records and remaining state

The audit record is [internal/records/2026-11-11-editor-inspector-matrix-projection-sync.md](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/main/internal/records/2026-11-11-editor-inspector-matrix-projection-sync.md). It records the gap, the synced fields, the verification above, and the original-condition accounting for `745.body.Acceptance.1`, `745.body.Acceptance.3` and `745.body.CurrentDirection.InspectorDelta`.

A small follow-up, [PR #1431](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1431), adds the matrix-checker and suite evidence to that record. It is open and awaiting independent review; its exact-head checks pass.

#745 is not closed by this comment. #514 remains the single matrix authority, and #531's completed research, its option-C recommendation and the engine infrastructure exemption are unchanged. Acceptance of the deferred Inspector/editor execution remains 0.4 work.

## #745 · correction: observed causes of the 55 residual failures

<!-- p745-consumerrows-sync-1429-cause-correction-c60926b -->

Correcting one claim in the two preceding comments. They attributed part of the 55 residual `prototype-coverage` failures to "the GPUI native-receipt cases lack their bound receipts". That was inferred from the test names rather than read from the retained failure bodies, and it is wrong. The record on [PR #1431](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1431) now states the observed causes.

Reading the complete failure bodies gives exactly two causes:

- **50 of 55** fail inside `refreshCandidateSource` with `Catalog entity P-BASE-MENUBAR cites multiple base families (menu-primitives, menubar) without one inherited Base family`.
- **5 of 55** fail candidate-source validation with `ENOENT ... internal/fixtures/shadcn-style-source/LICENSE.md`, because the retained Shadcn style manifest pins that file at the fixture root while it is stored under `upstream/`.

The GPUI receipt cases sit inside both groups: they abort at that earlier catalog or candidate-source step and never reach receipt validation, so their named receipts are not the cause. The `P-BASE-MENUBAR` ambiguity is the dominant cause, not the missing `LICENSE.md` fixture.

This correction does not change any delivered result. The 11 `Consumer source field drift` errors that this work targeted remain 0 on the candidate, the 5/5 focused cases remain 5/5, the 120-case suite remains 69 failures before and 55 after with no case regressed, and the merged content of [PR #1429](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/pull/1429) is unchanged. The two causes above are pre-existing source-state gaps in this checkout and remain with #870's reconciliation; they are not evidence about the editor projection either way.

Issue state is unchanged and remains open.
